summary:
The maintained read-only retained preflight authenticates original same-repository successful run/artifact custody, exact bounded v4 ZIP and original manifest source, then uses current verifier source and file hashes for custody and strict both-feed occupancy. It keeps publicationAuthorized=false, original source/archive identity, sanitized bounded diagnostics and typed member/feed dispositions. No-push candidate qualification preserves original Commands Unknown. These observations never authorize publication or rewrite earlier Unknown reservations.

Only first-page scoped Commands404 can opt into same-token native active organization-owner authority. The explicit package-read token must bind /user login/numeric ID, canonical organization numeric ID and native active/admin membership with exact joins, read:packages/read:org capabilities and no incomplete SSO response. A complete bounded unfiltered organization NuGet inventory with unique IDs/case-normalized names and validated owner/type/visibility may then prove the omitted namespace absent. Public-readable lists, repository administration, token scope alone or a separate account-role witness cannot establish package-token visibility. Listed-but-unreadable, denied/malformed/later-page responses, redirects and incomplete populations remain Unknown. Sanitized witness metadata retains counts/pages/time and population digest, never the package inventory.

Explicit retained promotion selects original run, ZIP hash, source and stable version from protected-main dispatch. It authenticates the complete successful original qualification-job population, runs current source-test job definitions against original source without protected credentials, and freshly qualifies retained CLI/API/Knowledge packages using current checks. Current protected code reauthenticates the ZIP/custody and fresh occupancy in the publisher; packing is excluded and packages keep their original source. Existing Contracts7.6 reuse, both-feed writes and eight readbacks remain. Normal and retained rails share a non-cancelling current-workflow fence; older workflow revisions keep their prior groups and require independent actor/reservation reconciliation. Authority-backed inventory is an observation, not a provider atomic no-overwrite contract. Source checks, source merge and read-only results establish no actual authenticated occupancy, feed availability, dispatch, publication or consumer acceptance. Root retains live-effect admission and full Delivery disposition.
title: Retained promotion separates original package custody from current verifier authority
